The best LiFePO4 battery charger depends on your battery voltage (12V, 24V, or 48V), capacity (Ah), and how quickly you want to charge it.

For most 12V LiFePO4 batteries used in RVs, solar systems, boats, and off-grid setups, I'd focus on three brands:

Victron Energy — Best overall for charging performance, reliability, and configurable settings.

NOCO — Best for convenient, portable charging and occasional maintenance.

LiTime — Best value for charging larger LiFePO4 batteries at higher currents.

A dedicated LiFePO4 charging mode is important. A typical 12V (12.8V nominal) LiFePO4 battery uses a charging voltage around 14.2–14.6V, depending on the manufacturer's specifications.
